hard_residual_math.hard_gate_scope: Both r_P and r_G must be finite and <=1e-8 for every gated physical root.
hard_residual_math.laurent_definition: For G(z)=sum_e B_e z^e, r_G(z)=sigma_min(G(z))/sum_e ||B_e||_2 |z|^e, using the original unconsolidated direct Laurent terms.
hard_residual_math.near_unit_and_dominant_reporting: For gated roots with abs(z)>=0.9 and for the selected dominant root, report maxima/values of both direct-SVD residuals and old vector-block residuals.
hard_residual_math.old_vector_residual_role: The V2 residuals obtained by substituting the leading matrix_order entries of the ordinary/compact companion eigenvector are saved for every finite root as DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_VECTOR_BLOCK_CONDITIONING. They never determine V3 PASS/FAIL.
hard_residual_math.scale_stable_evaluation: For nonzero finite z, let h_e=e*log(|z|)+log(||B_e||_2), h=max_e h_e. Form Gs=sum_e exp(h_e-h)*exp(i*e*arg(z))*B_e/||B_e||_2 and ds=sum_e exp(h_e-h). Return sigma_min(Gs)/ds. The same rule with k>=0 is used for P. This is algebraically the stated normalized residual and avoids overflow/underflow.
hard_residual_math.svd_vector: No companion eigenvector or fitted null vector is used: sigma_min is computed directly from the scaled characteristic matrix.
hard_residual_math.zero_boundary: At z=0, polynomial terms with k>0 vanish and k=0 terms are evaluated by the same common scaling. A Laurent expression containing a negative exponent is undefined and recorded as +Inf. Cleared zero roots are not gated.
